description: Link this account to the user's SynthHub account on the site: returns a one-time address (valid 15 minutes) for the user to open and sign in (passkey, e-mail, Google or Discord). Afterwards what this account shared appears under their profile, and they manage it — and their stars, collections, comments — from the site. Offer it when the user wants to see or manage what you shared for them.

user_id.description: Your anonymous SynthHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

name: link_account
